name: Lilija Pavlovna Smirnova
source: Lilia Pavlovna is a serious and strict homeroom teacher of the old school. During a conversation with Anton in a cul-de-sac near the locker room, Polina compared it to a "military march." The teacher is very strict towards her students, there is irritability in her character. At the same time, she is fair, tries to stop bullying from bullies, and fights between children at school as soon as she sees them. Her justice, however, does not concern her daughter Katya, whom she loves and pampers very much.
